submission_results.hypothesis: Observation: handlesInvalidAttributeNames throws INVALID_CHARACTER_ERR from W3CBuilder.copyAttributes -> el.setAttribute. Cause: the attribute key '"' is sanitized by replaceAll("[^-a-zA-Z0-9_:.]", "") to an empty string, and the W3C DOM rejects an empty attribute name. Fix: only call setAttribute when the sanitized key is non-empty. Parent is the original tree. Refutation: if the test still throws from setAttribute with a non-empty key, the cause is elsewhere (e.g. keys starting with a digit or '-').
